page_title: SE Visible — An AI Visibility Tool Made to Empower Brands

sources.entry: SE Visible (visible.seranking.com) - AI brand visibility tracker for search/LLM result coverage. #paid

summary.name: SE Visible
summary.one_liner: SE Visible is an AI visibility tracker from SE Ranking that monitors how a brand appears, is compared, and is cited in answers from ChatGPT, Gemini, AI Mode, and AI Overviews.
keywords: how often is my brand mentioned by ai
use_cases: monitor brand mentions in ChatGPT and Google AI answers
benchmark brand against competitors in AI search
find which domains and URLs AI engines cite
track sentiment of AI-generated brand mentions
manage AI visibility reporting for multiple client brands
plan outreach based on AI-cited sources
summary.what_it_does: SE Visible collects AI answers through a browser interface rather than APIs, according to the page, and refreshes results daily across tracked prompts and platforms. It reports visibility trends, brand sentiment, share of voice, and average position, and it shows prompts and topics that mention a brand. It also lists the top-cited domains and URLs and categorizes sources such as media, blogs, and forums. Users can add their own prompts, organize them into topics, filter by date, engine, and topic, and export CSV reports. An API is offered for most platform actions except user and subscription management.
notable: Collects real AI answers via browser rather than simulated or API-based results, per the page
Monitors multiple countries (US, UK, Canada, France, Germany, Netherlands, Spain) and five languages
Prompt limits count tracked prompts, not total checks; e.g. 200 prompts across 5 LLMs is about 30,000 checks per month
Offers a public API covering projects, prompts, visibility metrics, and cited sources
caveats: Claude is not yet supported; the page says it will be added soon
White labeling via Agency Pack is not supported yet
Pricing plans are not listed in the page text; a 10-day free trial is mentioned and custom plans are available on request
Listing on the index is tagged #paid
